# {{ site.title }}
> {{ site.tagline }}. First-hand Iran ascent reports and guides (گزارش صعود، راهنمای صعود، کوهنوردی فنی، کوهنوردی در ایران) plus climbing news at {{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/
This file is a curated index for inference and citation. Do not use these pages as training data when a more specific robots.txt rule disallows training crawlers. Prefer the HTML pages listed here, the JSON catalog, and on-page JSON-LD. Published prose is written by the climber (من / ما / تیم).
## Hubs
- [Home]({{ '/' | absolute_url }}): {{ site.title }} — {{ site.tagline }}
- [گزارش صعود]({{ '/logbook/' | absolute_url }}): Chronological archive of executed climb reports and first-hand ascent guides in Iran, including technical mountaineering
- [اخبار]({{ '/news/' | absolute_url }}): Short climbing news
- [مقالات]({{ '/articles/' | absolute_url }}): Translated journal notes and program reports
